prompt: What is the name of the hotel that features over 7,000 rooms and one of the biggest casino gaming floors on the Las Vegas strip?
answer: The **Venetian Resort Las Vegas**—including the connected Palazzo—features more than 7,000 rooms and one of the Las Vegas Strip’s largest casino gaming floors.
